title: v4.1.4 hardened OpenClaw Gateway startup
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; $so=Join-Path $root 'gateway-before-050u.stdout.json'; $se=Join-Path $root 'gateway-before-050u.stderr.txt'; Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try{$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList @('gateway','status','--json') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se; Write-Output ('V414_050U_PRESTATUS_EXIT='+$p.ExitCode)}catch{Write-Output 'V414_050U_PRESTATUS_UNAVAILABLE'}; Write-Output 'V414_050U_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; function Run-OC([string[]]$Args,[string]$Tag){$so=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stdout.txt');$se=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.stderr.txt');Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList $Args -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;return $p.ExitCode}; $code=Run-OC @('gateway','status','--json') 'gateway-probe-050u'; if($code -ne 0){$install=Run-OC @('gateway','install') 'gateway-install-050u'; if($install -ne 0){$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($null -eq $task){throw ('GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED code='+$install)}}}; $restart=Run-OC @('gateway','restart') 'gateway-restart-050u'; if($restart -ne 0){throw ('GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED code='+$restart)}; $ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 12;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $so=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050u.stdout.json';$se=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050u.stderr.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList @('gateway','status','--json') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se;if($p.ExitCode -eq 0){try{$null=Get-Content $so -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$ok=$true;break}catch{}}}; if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_NOT_HEALTHY_JSON'}; Write-Output 'V414_050U_GATEWAY=PASS'
test: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $p=Join-Path $root 'gateway-after-050u.stdout.json'; if(-not(Test-Path $p)){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_ARTIFACT_MISSING'}; $null=Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $cfg=Get-Content (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw/openclaw.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; if([string]$cfg.gateway.mode -ne 'local'){throw 'GATEWAY_MODE_NOT_LOCAL'}; $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($null -eq $task){$startup=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup'; $f=Get-ChildItem $startup -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'OpenClaw'}; if($null -eq $f){throw 'GATEWAY_AUTOSTART_NOT_FOUND'}}; Write-Output 'V414_050U_TEST=PASS'
